description: We are two high school students passionate about science and space exploration since childhood. Fascinated by the universe and its mysteries, we want to turn our curiosity into an ambitious and innovative project. We are looking for like-minded people who share our passion, especially those with skills in coding, web development, or digital design. Above all, we want to build a motivated team, learn from each other, develop our skills, and turn our ideas into reality !
summary:
We developed "Acrozma", an interactive web-based guide designed to help users explore Mars and understand the challenges of future human missions.

The platform features an interactive 3D globe of Mars with clickable locations, including Jezero Crater, Gale Crater, and Elysium Planitia. Each location provides scientific information, geographical details, and connections to past or ongoing NASA missions. Users can also experience a simulated Martian surface, adjusting the local time and lighting to better understand the planet's environment.

Additionally, our Marswalk planner allows users to select exploration areas, choose scientific stops, adjust walking speed and time limits, and generate an exportable mission brief.

By combining scientific information with interactive exploration and mission planning, Mars Atlas makes Mars more accessible and helps users understand the geographical and logistical challenges of exploring another planet. It offers an educational starting point for imagining future human exploration of Mars.
details:
Acrozma is an interactive web platform designed to help users explore Mars and better understand the challenges of future human exploration.

The project combines several features into one experience. Users can explore an interactive 3D map of Mars, discover important geographical locations such as Jezero Crater, Gale Crater, and Elysium Planitia, and access scientific information about these areas. The platform also includes a Martian environment simulation, allowing users to experience aspects of the planet's surface and changing lighting conditions. Additionally, our Marswalk planner lets users select exploration areas, choose scientific stops, set walking speeds and time limits, and generate an exportable mission brief.

The main benefit of Mars Atlas is that it makes information about Mars more accessible and engaging. Instead of simply reading scientific data, users can interact with the planet, explore its geography, and experiment with basic mission-planning scenarios. Our intended impact is to raise awareness of the scientific and logistical challenges of future human missions to Mars and encourage curiosity about space exploration.

We developed the project using Runable.com and Visual Studio Code. Our technologies and resources included HTML and CSS, JavaScript and Python. We also used EduPython for testing and ReactBits to integrate some visual effects and interactive elements.

What makes Mars Atlas creative is the way it brings geographical exploration, environmental simulation, and mission planning together in a single platform. During development, we considered accessibility, ease of use, scientific relevance, visual clarity, and the importance of making the experience both informative and interactive.
